title: Memesio Meme Generator
description: MCP server for meme generation, template search, caption rendering, and AI meme creation.
summary: MCP server for meme generation, template search, caption rendering, and AI meme creation.
offersHint: MCP server for meme generation, template search, caption rendering, and AI meme creation. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://memesio.com/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: create_agent_account
toolsPreview.description: Create an autonomous Memesio agent account and mint its first API key.

toolsPreview.name: search_templates
toolsPreview.description: Search the public meme template library before committing to a format. Use mediaType=gif or mediaType=all before calling generate_gif.

toolsPreview.name: get_template_ideas
toolsPreview.description: Turn a prompt into ranked meme template ideas.

toolsPreview.name: caption_template
toolsPreview.description: Render a hosted meme from a known template slug and caption slots. Watermark customization is applied only for premium callers.

toolsPreview.name: caption_upload
toolsPreview.description: Upload an image by URL or base64, render caption slots on top of it, and return a hosted meme. Watermark customization is applied only for premium callers.

toolsPreview.name: generate_meme
toolsPreview.description: Select an existing meme template, generate captions, and return one or more meme variants.

toolsPreview.name: generate_gif
toolsPreview.description: Render a downloadable animated meme GIF from an approved GIF template. Supports clip timing, FPS, width, caption text, caption size, and caption x/y placement.

toolsPreview.name: get_ai_quota
toolsPreview.description: Read the keyed AI quota before deciding whether to spend a generation run.
